name: Block Incremental [New🔥]
desc:
Welcome to Block Incremental! 👋

This game is all about numbers going up and getting on the leaderboards, with regular updates adding new content to the game. 🎉 

📗 - A lot of different Block Tiers to discover!
🏆 - Show off your progress and climb the leaderboards! 
💾 - Your progress gets saved! 
✨ - Roblox Plus members get 1.2x Walkspeed and Blocks!

We would appreciate it if you could Favorite ⭐ and like 👍 the game!
